description: Produce or refine a YUNEX automotive film while keeping previously approved 3D assets intact.

Read `AGENTS.md` and `production/README.md`, inspect the actual YUNEX composition, source SHA and authorised asset rights. Make changes on a new project branch only when requested. Report exact proof links and outstanding blockers.
